title: Reflexivity of reaching
statement: Let $P$ be a register program with oracle, let $c_0$ and $c$ be configurations on the same input, let $r$ be a work-tape register, and let $p\in\mathbb{Z}$. Then $c_0$ reaches itself relative to the reference configuration $c$, register $r$, and position $p$.
